description:
Autonomous post-quantum WAN mesh routing daemon and serverless traffic sharding VPN

Vantablack is an autonomous peer-to-peer mesh routing daemon written in pure Rust.
It enables personal computers, servers, and edge devices to communicate securely across the
public internet without central servers, commercial VPN providers, or trusted Certificate Authorities.
Featuring hybrid ML-KEM-768 / X25519 cryptography, Reed-Solomon RS(2,1) multi-path sharding,
ShardSec per-shard authentication, SessionGuard anti-replay sliding window, and instant local SOCKS5 proxy.
